name: Food for the Taking
summary: Krom'rosh sends you to an Alliance farm in Meadowsbrook for its feed. Taking the supplies will hinder the humans and buy time to plan the next move.

sections.title: The Farm's Stores
sections.body: The Alliance farm in Meadowsbrook holds feed that Krom'rosh wants taken. You are sent to the southwest to seize what you find, denying the humans supplies and buying time for another plan.

faq.answer: Krom'rosh wants you to take feed from the Alliance farm in Meadowsbrook.
The Alliance farm is in Meadowsbrook, to the southwest.
Taking the supplies will deny the humans their provisions and buy time to plan the next move.
The supplies are Feed Satchels from the Alliance farm.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you are asked to deny the Alliance humans the comfort and sustenance of their farm supplies.

attribution: In-game quest text: Food for the Taking
